phase: Rosetta Research Workbench Phase I Slice 5
purpose: Verify provenance completeness, stale-state fail-closed behavior, semantic-firewall invariants, synthetic/empirical separation, rights/media boundaries, and deterministic rendering across the current Workbench surface.
provenance_requirements: Every displayed scientific record must carry a nonempty provenance_ids list.
Every displayed provenance ID must resolve through exactly one provenance namespace.
Core, event and evidence provenance namespaces may not collide.
Nested Claim-Evidence Link records are displayed scientific records and require resolvable provenance.
stale_state_requirements: Any authority_state other than CURRENT fails closed.
Missing semantic owners or required authority bindings fail closed.
The current chimp pilot fallback must project D0019_PR0005_EMPIRICAL_CLOSED_MIXED with aggregate results only; restricted source bytes, identities and row-level artifacts remain unavailable.

RUN-005 and RUN-006 are CLOSED with full-path MIXED disposition and no Group-1 model or preprocessing refit. Historical EMPIRICAL_EXECUTION_HELD with null dispositions remains a producer regression case.

CRG-C is PASS; CRG-D is PARTIAL and controlling; overall chimp comparison readiness remains NOT_COMPARISON_READY and Bonobo activation remains DEFERRED. Closure earns no replicated H0001, semantic, translation, causal or species-wide compositionality claim.
semantic_firewall_requirements: meaning, translation, semantic_gloss and english_gloss keys are forbidden recursively within displayed scientific records.
D0020 Goal_* values remain anonymized source codes and unreleased gesture form remains NOT_RELEASED_IN_ANON_CSV.
The D0020 registered null/context-sufficient result remains bounded to its frozen representation/target and may not become a species-wide absence claim.
ZERO_SYNTHETIC software verification remains biological_evidence=false and stays segregated from empirical runs.
Empty contradiction/disagreement registries remain registry state only and never become evidence of absence.
Rights-aware media placeholders expose no bytes, preview, media URL, image URL, preview URL, synthesized thumbnail, reconstructed media or substitute media.
determinism_requirement: Repeated rendering of the same frozen Workbench fixture must yield the same overview, evidence and event service state apart from explicitly live access/status metadata.
completion_rule: Slice 5 is software-complete only after the exact branch head passes unit/contract tests, the dedicated Slice 5 receipt, all prior Workbench slice receipts, receiver-harness regressions and exact-head artifact upload, followed by promotion of the identical tested tree to main.
separate_open_gate: Slice 5 completion does not satisfy full Slice 2. The authenticated live canonical-producer execution against pinned Drive/ACEB authorities remains a separate operational gate.
